title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Darkfire Soldier #2 Pharaoh's Servant Psv-045 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Darkfire Soldier #2 character from the Pharaoh's Servant set. It is a rare and collectible card with a 1st Edition status. The card is in English language and has the card number PSV-045. 

The card's attributes include a Fire color, Pyro creature/monster type, and 1100 defense/toughness. It also has an attack/power of 1700 and is a Normal card type. This card is perfect for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game and collectors alike.
